## Names

<a id="ai_attack_facing_table"></a>
### [`ai_attack_facing_table`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L6) `$2102-$2151`

*data*

Attack choice when the fighters have different facings. Index = distance + $33 + random spread: $08-$32 opponent behind, $33-$47 in front. Values are move commands.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update) [`$1F6D`](../../../../src/ai/ai_opponent.asm#L315)

<a id="ai_attack_same_facing_table"></a>
### [`ai_attack_same_facing_table`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L18) `$2152-$21A0`

*data*

Attack choice when both fighters have the same facing. Index = distance + $29 + random spread: $08-$28 opponent in front, $29-$47 behind.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update) [`$1FB8`](../../../../src/ai/ai_opponent_1f8f.asm#L32)

<a id="ai_special_jump_table"></a>
### [`ai_special_jump_table`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L30) `$21A1-$21B2`

*data*

Addresses of the special actions 1-8; entry 0 ($0000) is never used. Read at $20f5 and $20fa.

- **Read by:** [`ai_dispatch_special`](ai_opponent_1f8f.md#ai_dispatch_special) [`$20F5`](../../../../src/ai/ai_opponent_1f8f.asm#L234), [`ai_dispatch_special`](ai_opponent_1f8f.md#ai_dispatch_special) [`$20FA`](../../../../src/ai/ai_opponent_1f8f.asm#L236) (+1)

### [`ai_special_by_move`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L35) `$21B3-$21CB`
